scope_support.feedback_quote: Campaigns demonstrate progressive refinement and recovery through hypothesis revision, yielding a best composite score 11.0% above the experience-stage record.
scope_support.object_quote: Abstraction organizes these observations into conditional principles linking reinforcement placement, crack evolution and load transfer, with supporting evidence and failure conditions.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Generalization challenges the model to combine these principles in new architectures and surpass the earlier design record.
